review_evidence: The 1,745-file HOL src/ unit was classified by top-level subsystem and scanned for object-level theory-construction markers. Mathematical/theory-bearing subtrees such as algebra, probability, real, list, quotient, finite_maps, datatype, solver theory scripts, HolyHammer demos and TacticToe demos/selftests remain searchable.

The selected host/tooling subtrees were inspected structurally and with representative source reads: `0`/`experimental-kernel` implement term/type/net kernel data structures, `prekernel` implements context/tag/signature infrastructure, `postkernel` implements theory storage/kernel utilities/proof tracing, `portableML` is generic SML portability/data-structure support, `AI` is ML/proof-search/SML-inspection tooling, `parse` is grammar/parser/pretty-printer infrastructure, and `tracing` serializes proof/theory traces.

Targeted grep for `new_theory`, theorem blocks, definitions and theorem storage found no standalone object-level HOL theory scripts in the selected runtime/parser/kernel/tracing subtrees; apparent theorem/definition words in AI/parse/postkernel occur in host APIs, comments or theory-management code.

rules.content_invariant: Its nine SML/signature files implement KernelTypes, Term, Type, Net and substitution structures and contain no standalone HOL theory creation or theorem script.
evidence: Complete subtree inventory; representative core files inspected and object-theory marker scan found no theory scripts.
rules.rationale: This subtree is the minimal host-language kernel representation layer, not an object-level HOL theory.

rules.rationale: This subtree is host-language theory-management/kernel utility/proof-trace infrastructure.

rules.rationale: This subtree implements theorem-prover ML/premise-selection/proof-search and SML-inspection tooling, not an object-level mathematical library.

summary: Reviewed the large HOL src unit conservatively: object-level mathematical theories and theorem-bearing demos/tests remain searchable, while eight clearly host-language kernel/runtime/parser/search/tracing implementation subtrees are excluded.
